title: The Provisional Figure a Keyturn Host Protection Plan Claim Is Opened At
content:
A claim is opened on an enrolment of the Keyturn Host Protection Plan at a provisional figure, which is what the marketplace puts on the loss before anything is appraised.

### The figure

The provisional figure starts from the ceiling the plan carries for damage to the body and paint of the vehicle. That ceiling is what the claim is opened at, and the figure is rounded half up to two decimal places once, at the end and never at an intermediate step. Every figure the plan publishes, its ceilings for each kind of loss among them, is read from the plan the enrolment is written on.

### Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A loss is to be put on an enrolment before it is valued | The ceiling the plan carries for damage to the body and paint of the vehicle | That ceiling, to the cent, is the amount the claim is opened at |

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

Take a hypothetical enrolment whose plan publishes a ceiling of 26000 for damage to the body and paint of the vehicle. The provisional figure is that ceiling, and the claim is opened at 26000.00, the rounding half up to two decimal places being done once on that result.
